limits: Reservoir vector polygons are comparison scopes, not contemporaneous water truth.
Mask storage validity is not sensor observation validity; binary-mask nodata may equal zero.
Low coverage can reflect drawdown, invalid observations, vector mismatch or recognition error; it is not a measured omission rate.
C0-C4 stages are frozen first-round upstream variants before vector deduction.
Parent polygons may overlap; do not sum their areas as an AOI total.

C2 evidence precedes A1/A2 changes; C4 nonwater inside vector scope is not ground-truth omission. Numeric probability includes prior/default evidence and does not prove valid observation. Source codes are retained without inventing class meanings. Descriptive 0.5/0.7 bins are not proposed model thresholds.
No thresholds changed, no water restored and no volume calculated.
